21: #include "AntiDetection.h"
22: #include "BotConfig.h"
23: #include <iostream>
24: #include <thread>
25: 
26: int main()
27: {
28:     // Step 1: Launch D2R.exe (must be running)
29:     // ... (start game separately)
30: 
31:     // Step 2: Initialize bot

36:     }

41:         std::cerr << "Failed to apply spoofing" << std::endl;
